items.title: Micron Is 44% Below Its High With Over 75% of Its 2027 Output Already Committed
items.summary: Key TakeawaysMicron is 44% below its 52-week high after a 20% fall in the past month, as GF Securities warned NAND flash could move into surplus in 2027. Over 75% of Micron’s 2027 output is committed, but its contracted minimum revenue for the next 12 months covers only about an eighth of fiscal 2027 consensus.
